scripts.fix: markdownlint-cli2 --fix && textlint --fix --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.md' && vp fmt && vp run -r check --fix
scripts.lint: vp run lint:md && vp run lint:text && vp run lint:spell && vp run lint:secret && vp run lint:actions
scripts.test: vp run --filter './packages/*' build && vp run -r test
scripts.generate: vp run --filter './packages/*' build && vp run --filter @effect-to-openapi/test generate
scripts.example: vp run --filter './packages/*' build && vp run --filter @effect-to-openapi/example example
